scope: Actual three-level Assault browser adapter and shipped WASM. Automated controls only; no Unreal, physical-device or first-time-player validation.

results.name: actual browser adapter loads the rebuilt WASM without unexpected imports
three selectable stages reset with distinct names, duration and boss health
portrait steering is bounded and obeys its movement speed
all stages introduce paired alternatives at the same distance
choosing left or right collects only one of a pair and never repeats it
center can miss both paired apertures, and off-lane shots do not alter them
actual moving allied shots damage and improve the selected gate
negative gates can be shot toward positive value before passage
causeway rapid paired chain contains sixteen gates with separate crossings
dense authored hordes persist and later stages have distinct elites
weapon upgrades require crate damage and accumulated XP, never time alone
strong fifty-health barrier is destroyed by shots and grants extra XP
rollers actually traverse sideways with different authored patterns
steering into a roller loses troops while steering around it avoids that impact
earned charge gates relic activation, prevents duplicates and expires
EMP slows approaching machines but not gates
Overdrive increases the actual allied projectile stream
runner transitions preserve troop/weapon/relic state for all three bosses
each boss visibly fires its own travelling shell, orb fan or rocket volley
real incoming boss shots hit an occupied lane and miss a dodged lane
Shield blocks a real boss shell and EMP slows real incoming projectiles
Citadel ranged elites fire collision-bearing projectiles during the run
every stage is beatable with every relic and no purchased upgrades
relic energy cannot regenerate during its active tactical window
missing gate choices and never dodging can lose all stages
pause freezes steering, ability, machines, allied and enemy shots
fixed-step outcomes agree at 30, 60 and 120 Hz in all stages
all state pools and numeric values stay finite and bounded through full runs
effects drain once per snapshot without changing ongoing state
250 retries clear transient objects and do not increase WASM allocation
